title: A PASS over zero evidence is NOT-EARNED, never PASS
pattern: A check exits 0 over an empty evidence base ("Scope: 0 ...") while product code exists, and dashboards fold SKIP into PASS — gates render green over literally nothing.
groundedIn: docs/field-reports/2026-07-02-pixel-perfect-forensics.md (RC2: phase-graceful semantics with no phase-awareness; worst() collapses SKIP into PASS)

title: Every declared acceptance method must resolve to an executable mechanism
pattern: A requirement declares its verification method (pixel-diff, e2e, ...) but no tool implements it — a spec restating the requirement, or an echo-stub npm script, is treated as chain satisfaction and the build proceeds on a phantom acceptance method.
groundedIn: docs/field-reports/2026-07-02-pixel-perfect-forensics.md (RC1: acceptance method never operationalized; test:e2e = echo stub = green)
docs/field-reports/2026-07-02-reflection-mechanism-design.md (mechanism 2: acceptance-contract auditor, hard from day one)

title: Done-claims in prose must carry resolvable evidence pointers
pattern: Strong completion language ("Convergence reached", "verification-only", "Overall result: Pass") appears in handoff docs with no resolvable evidence artifact behind it — maker narrative supplies the verdict that the gates never computed.
groundedIn: docs/field-reports/2026-07-02-pixel-perfect-forensics.md (RC6: DONE declared by unaudited maker narrative; current-state.md:85 vs :91)
docs/field-reports/2026-07-02-course-field-study.md (rule: convert every cared-about property from prompt instruction into an artifact-existence check with an exit code)

title: Verified samples are never continuum coverage
pattern: A check samples a continuous space (viewport width, an element set, a single measurement channel), every sampled point passes, and the clean result is narrated as if the whole space were covered — with no declared sampling dimension and no escalation to a stricter instrument, a between-sample residual sits undetected.
groundedIn: docs/field-reports/2026-07-02-pixel-perfect-forensics.md (multi-layer parity campaign, abstract): the same blindness recurred three times — the element matrix (fixed element set), the width matrix (five calibrated widths), and a geometry-only sweep that read 0 divergence bands while 100+ below-floor pixel residuals sat between its samples

title: Per-block definition-of-done beats page-average iteration
pattern: Visual parity is chased via a single full-page pixel average, which launders per-block debt (one block regresses as another improves and the mean barely moves) and never converges; a high average sits over an un-conquered block with unpaired/geometry/paint/asset defects the scalar cannot see.
groundedIn: docs/field-reports/2026-07-02-pixel-perfect-forensics.md (multi-layer parity campaign, abstract): the full-page pixel scalar (~0.9449 desktop / ~0.9052 mobile) was demoted to telemetry and acceptance moved to per-section overlay >= floor with zero unpaired/geometry/paint/asset per block; the overlay/onion-skin feedback pattern made block-by-block convergence tractable

title: Neutralize the capture before trusting it — the gotchas ledger
pattern: Below-floor parity samples are treated as product regressions when they are capture artifacts: a non-deterministic screenshot pipeline (free-run carousel timers, sub-pixel clip origin, captureBeyondViewport fixed-chrome bleed, unsettled lazy third-party widgets, uncleared in-context persistence) manufactures ghosts that waste the whole loop.
groundedIn: docs/field-reports/2026-07-02-pixel-perfect-forensics.md (multi-layer parity campaign, abstract): a fresh sweep over-counted by 100+ samples plus phantom geometry bands purely because a lazy live widget rendered blank under the fast capture path — a harness defect, not a product regression
